facts.description: Open source voice-to-text for the terminal. Record from a hotkey, transcribe with any provider, pipe to AI or shell commands.

research.name: OSTT
research.note: Terminal voice-to-text popup that draws a live mirrored waveform while recording, then pastes the transcript.

effects: live mirrored audio waveform drawn in a small terminal popup while recording
hotkey popup that records, shows a transcribing state, then drops the text into the focused editor
